title: Use the current-v19 unique retained main-base source for Player City scans

scope.userRegression: Full Player City scans traversed the world but returned only roughly 279-403 rows.

rootCause.finding: _pointInfos is a current response/delta representation in current v19 and can omit retained player bases already present in WorldPointManager state.
rootCause.replacementMeaning: public/xLua-wrapped unique BuildPointInfo main-base list retained by the current WorldPointManager

implementation.cityCollector: GetAllMainBaseList with direct call then reflected fallback
implementation.filtering: returned unique main bases are filtered back to the exact native AOI footprint proven by each response
implementation.matchedCityCount: is derived from the same published City snapshot

historicalComparison.interpretation: City counts are population-dependent and are not fixed invariants; exact full-world coverage plus publish/reopen equality is the acceptance invariant.

tests.generatedAdapterGuard: pins GetAllMainBaseList City ownership, rejects _pointInfos inside city_aoi_records, and pins matchedCityCount to the published snapshot

postValidation.defaultDeterministicSuite: PASS; ok=true; all six groups true; failures=[]

privacy: No player names, player IDs, coordinates, raw City records, session challenge or request identifiers are stored in this evidence file.
limits: The live City count is not treated as a stable population invariant.
This checkpoint changes Player City acquisition only; Resource, Dispatch, Ghost, Treasure, Truck, Railway and Monster source ownership are not broadened.
Truck, Railway and Dispatch still require their own fresh read-only live acceptance after R7-102.
